## Summary

1. **Investigated deployment history**: Found v2.3.1 (unhealthy) was the latest deploy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions**: The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving a mixed state with us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1 at 18% error rate. A retry completed the rollout.
3. **Verified recovery**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy.
